title: pretty KALIA|Plus Size Hollow Out Sleeveless Empire Waist Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
Radiate elegance in our dress. This stunning dress features a chic hollow-out design and a flattering empire waist that enhances your silhouette. Crafted from lightweight chiffon, it offers comfort and grace, perfect for bridesmaids at any wedding celebration. Designed to flatter curvy figures, this dress ensures you look and feel beautiful on the special day.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
